summary: Re-tested ONLY the mobile NotificationBell settings-panel centering fix and desktop regression per iteration_17 request. Both viewports PASS — panel is fully inside the viewport, correctly centered on mobile, and right-aligned near the bell on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix at /app/frontend/src/components/NotificationBell.jsx line 162 is correct: replacing transform-based centering (which framer-motion was clobbering) with left-4 right-4 mx-auto positional centering on mobile is a robust approach. The sm: overrides cleanly switch to right-aligned dropdown on desktop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_17 confirmed NotificationBell settings panel centering fix works on both mobile (390px, panel centered at x=195, x=35, right=355, fully within viewport) and desktop (1440px, right-aligned to bell at right=933, width=288). No further action needed on this fix. Backend delete/promo dismiss/admin delete were validated in iteration_16 and were NOT re-tested per main agent instruction.
rca of the issue: N/A — validation of prior fix. The prior overflow (x=195, width=320, right=515 on 390px viewport) was caused by framer-motion applying its own transform, which overrode the tailwind '-translate-x-1/2' used for centering. The new implementation uses positional centering (fixed left-4 right-4 max-w-xs mx-auto) that framer-motion does not touch, so the panel now sits at x=35 with width=320 → right=355, fully within the 390px viewport.
